name: Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies (Social Sciences)
notes: Five GSWS courses (20 credits). SBAI offers TWO GSWS minors, one in the humanities and one in the social sciences; each is a separate entry here (minor-gsws-h and minor-gsws-ss).
Students may apply up to two courses taken abroad toward the GSW minor.

Core courses used for the minor must NOT be the required courses: the department states 'If you are completing a minor or major, you must take core courses that are not the required courses (GSWS 105, GSWS 200).' GSWS 105 and GSWS 200 are therefore excluded from the core group.
GSWS 100 (Topics in GSW) changes topic by semester and its humanities/social-science designation changes with it. Students may only take GSWS 100 once.

TRACK DESIGNATION NOT ENFORCEABLE for the two electives: the catalog records no H or SS designation per course, so the elective group accepts any GSWS course. One of the two must match your track - check the designation with SBAI.
The department page writes 'GSW' where the registrar's catalog uses GSWS.
The GSWS MAJORS are separate entries (major-gsws-h-ba and major-gsws-ss-ba).
